examples.en: Science journalism is the main channel for the popularization of scientific information among the public.
examples.zh: 科学新闻是在公众当中普及科学信息的主要渠道。

examples.en: The popularization of digital video recorders has caused advertisers to worry that their commercials will be skipped.
examples.zh: 数码录像机的普及让广告商担心他们的广告会被跳过。

examples.en: Popularization has in some cases changed the original meaning of emotional intelligence.
examples.zh: 在某些情况下，大众化改变了情商的本意。
